description: This file implements a video frame buffer class for WebRTC, managing memory pools for YUV plane data and providing methods to access frame dimensions and data pointers.

classes.name: CvdVideoFrameBuffer
classes.description: A class managing YUV video frame buffers with memory pooling for efficient reuse.

methods.name: CvdVideoFrameBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing frame buffer with specified width and height, allocating memory from pool.

methods.name: ~CvdVideoFrameBuffer
methods.description: Destructor returning memory buffers to the pool.

methods.name: width
methods.description: Returns the width of the video frame.

methods.name: height
methods.description: Returns the height of the video frame.

methods.name: StrideY
methods.description: Returns the stride (width in bytes) for the Y plane.

methods.name: StrideU
methods.description: Returns the stride for the U plane.

methods.name: StrideV
methods.description: Returns the stride for the V plane.

methods.name: DataY
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the Y plane data.

methods.name: DataU
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the U plane data.

methods.name: DataV
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the V plane data.
